title: "Ancillary study analyses (dis con)"
output: html_notebook
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set Environment and load packages
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(psych,
               ggplot2,
               tidyverse,
               magrittr,
               gmodels,
               foreign,
               ggcorrplot,
               Hmisc,
               DT,
               afex,
               lsmeans,
               rstatix,
               effectsize,
               stargazer)

setwd("")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
load("Ancillary Study cleaned and recoded data.rda")

# Filter out participants who met the exclusion criteria outlined in the pre-registration
cleaned %<>% filter(problem == 0)

# center predictors
cleaned$severity_c = scale(cleaned$severity, center=TRUE, scale=FALSE)
cleaned$covid_concern_c = scale(cleaned$covid_concern, center=TRUE, scale=FALSE)

# Composite illness harm predictor
cleaned %<>% rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(illness_harm = mean(c(trans_risk, severity), na.rm = TRUE))

# Low Covid concern
low_concern_df <- filter(cleaned, high_COVID_concern == 0)

```

## Primary Analyses

```{r descriptives}
psych::describe(select(cleaned, trans_risk, severity, centrality, salience, cur_stigma, fut_stigma, conceal_dv, conceal_vig))

cleaned %>% 
  group_by(conceal_dv) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(count = n()) %>% 
  arrange(conceal_dv) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r multiple regression}
# General concealment
conceal_lm <- lm(conceal ~ trans_risk + severity + centrality + salience + cur_stigma, data = cleaned)
summary(conceal_lm)

conceal_lm <- lm(conceal ~ illness_harm + centrality + salience + cur_stigma, data = cleaned)
summary(conceal_lm)

# Include concern as covariate
conceal_concern_lm <- lm(conceal ~ trans_risk + severity + centrality + salience + cur_stigma + covid_concern,
                 data = cleaned)

conceal_concern_lm <- lm(conceal ~ illness_harm + centrality + salience + cur_stigma + covid_concern,
                 data = cleaned)
summary(conceal_concern_lm)


# Only low COVID concern ps
# General concealment
conceal_lowconcern_lm <- lm(conceal ~ trans_risk + severity + centrality + salience + cur_stigma,
                            data = low_concern_df)

summary(conceal_lowconcern_lm)

# Formatted table
stargazer(conceal_lm, conceal_concern_lm, conceal_lowconcern_lm, type = "text", title = "Model Results",
          align = TRUE)
```
